title: Morning Exhibition — 2026-07-13
style: A contemporary layered-paper and mineral-pigment aesthetic: flattened bird silhouettes, refined cut edges, translucent washes, fine bark-like scoring and small jewel-toned accents. Let the birds feel recognisable through posture, colour blocks and distinctive markings rather than detailed naturalism.
palette: Sea-glass green, pale lichen, warm sandstone, weathered cream, soft charcoal, muted rose, bullfinch coral, goldcrest yellow, goldfinch ochre-gold, with tiny notes of nuthatch blue-grey and woodpecker red. Overall light should feel cool, northern and morning-clear.
mood: Delicate, composed and quietly joyful, with the feeling of birds glimpsed in a sheltered green place just after dawn. Calm rather than busy; intimate rather than scenic.

creative_brief.collection: Morning edition — a quiet woodland-chamber piece shaped by cool North Sea light and the soft clarity of an early summer day.

creative_brief.composition: Portrait format with a slender vertical structure suggesting a tree trunk or folded wooden screen slightly off-centre. Place the Bullfinch as the calm visual anchor in the lower-middle, rounded and still. Let the Goldcrest appear as a tiny luminous mark near the upper third, and the Treecreeper climb in a narrow vertical rhythm along the textured edge. Other birds should orbit as small, balanced presences across fine branch-lines and negative space, creating a gentle upward movement rather than a literal woodland scene.

presentation.decision_reason: A black mount gives the strongest restrained contrast with the artwork edge.
